{{Quote|He answers to 'Leebo,' when he bothers to answer at all. He thinks he's funny.|[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''LE-BO2D9''', nicknamed '''Leebo''', was a [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[LE-series repair droid]] owned by [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:DashLeebo-SOTETC.jpg|left|thumb|Leebo and Dash under fire]]
Being a basic issue of [[LE-series repair droid|LE repair droid]], Leebo worked in [[Esseles starport]] as a safety standards inspector. At one time, an unknown transport vessel took off while being checked by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], making Leebo an unwilling stowaway. From that moment forward, LE-BO2D9 began to work as a ship [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], going from one owner to another throughout the years. He served multiple masters (sometimes lost as [[sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] stake, sometimes exchanged as payoff) and each of them updated his abilities and skills, allowing Leebo to do more and more.<ref name="sotesb" />

He came to the hands of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] comedian [[Kood Gareeda]], working as his manager, arranging transportation, lodging and his performances throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]; the artist also had programmed Leebo with some "quirky" sense of humor, which was useful when the droid participated in his performances. The pair had experienced some dangerous situations, like when their humor angered the audience.<ref name="sotesb" />

It was one such time when Gareeda was on [[Rodia/Legends|his homeworld]], and satirized [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]], offending the audience. He arranged for a quick and safe passage off Rodia with a [[smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] Dash Rendar delivered Gareeda to [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]], and acquired the droid as payment.<ref name="sotesb" />

Dash, who seemed to believe his new possession acquired his former master's dry sense of humor, made his own modifications and upgrades, specifically installing a long-range, shielded single-channel [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a broad-band [[antenna/Legends|antenna]], and taught him how to repair and pilot the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]. With these, he was able to call Leebo to pick him from tight spots. The two had many adventures, and Leebo had the role of assessing new businesses and setting up meetings.<ref name="sotesb" />

Leebo accompanied Dash during his trip to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], piloting the ''Outrider'' away from [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] and into the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]]. He later aided Dash during his escapades on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], on bodyguard mission to protect [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] given by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], the assault on Imperial [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Suprosa]]'', and then the rescue of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from [[Xizor's Palace]], always guarding ''Outrider'' while offering Dash advice during his travels.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)" /> 

After the rescue of Princess Leia, he received Dash back to the ''Outrider''.<ref name="SE6" /> Leebo summoned the [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Quadron]] for support for their escape from [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]],<ref name="Secrets" /> and also piloted the ship at the [[Battle over Coruscant]], while Rendar was manning the [[Turret/Legends|gun turret]]. At the end of the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], Leebo was at the cockpit of the ''Outrider'' when Rendar made a last-second escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], avoiding destruction in the maelstrom of debris from the exploded ''Falleen's Fist''.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)" /> To everyone else, it seemed as if the ''Outrider'' was destroyed and everyone onboard were killed.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref name="SE6">[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Leebo.jpg|thumb|Leebo, working on the ''Outrider'']]
{{Quote|We'll never get paid if you stay here all day!|Leebo|audio=Leebo.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>}}
Leebo often carried a bag with necessary repair tools with him. Some of his worn out components were replaced by new ones throughout his operation, giving out a visual mixture of both old and new metal parts. Some of his cosmetic skin plating was removed to make space for onboard gear, and critical systems were reinforced with armor plating.<ref name="Secrets" /><ref name="sotesb" />

Equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], single-channel long-range [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] connected to Dash Rendar's [[wrist comm]], and [[Computer terminal|computer]] interface, he was a skilled mechanic and pilot.<ref name="sotesb" />

His programming, being updated by every owner, was far more sophisticated than that installed on stock LE repair droids, eventually becoming multilingual.<ref name="sotesb" />

Leebo was a feisty and trustwortly companion.<ref name="sotesb" /> Because he'd had few, if any, [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] throughout his life, he'd developed a personality and specific sense of humor.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We just thought Leebo was a neat nickname for a droid.|[[Jon Knoles]]|<ref name="Secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>}}
Leebo was named after [[LucasArts]] art department technical artist [[Mike Levine|Mike "Leebo" Levine]].<ref name="Secrets" />

Leebo was voiced by [[Tom Kane]] in [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|Shadows of The Empire]]. In the game.
